name: omnirank
description: Audit any website across SEO, answer-engine and generative-engine criteria, and generate llms.txt, llms-full.txt and facts.json so AI engines can ingest it as ground truth.

interface.longDescription: Score a site's SEO, AEO and GEO gates against its real HTML, then generate the machine-ingestible ground truth that generative engines read. Ships two skills: audit and geo-artifacts.
